description: Upsert the live state of a GitHub PR into the graph.

author.description: GitHub login that opened the PR.

created_at.description: GitHub creation timestamp (ISO-8601); a graph timestamp is used if omitted.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

draft.description: True while the PR is a draft (in-progress, not yet up for review).

head_sha.description: Head commit SHA (changes on each synchronize).

merged_at.description: GitHub merge timestamp (ISO-8601), or null if not merged.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

state.description: Lifecycle state: 'open' | 'closed' (merged PRs are closed with merged_at set).

name: cypher_upsert_pull_request
title: Upsert pull request
